replication.target_description: Current project, Online protocol after preregistered exclusions: initial offer of chips to angry versus happy recipients, all with low consequences of rejection. Table 2 standardized angry-minus-happy difference; Table 4 within-protocol emotion contrast with random intercept for testing site.

n.sample_role: Participants included in the protocol-specific target analysis after preregistered exclusions; all participants were assigned low consequences of rejection.
n.exclusions: 193 of 301 excluded under preregistered criteria: manipulation checks, doubt partner was real, familiarity with other subjects, or knowledge of ultimatum game. Category counts overlap and are pooled across revised and online protocols.

notes: Original locator p.10 corresponds to the published version; supplied accepted manuscript places the matching result on p.31. Original low-consequence subgroup n is not established from the full experiment total. Replication d is printed in Table 2, with direction angry minus happy; the p and Wald z are the authors' protocol-specific mixed-effects emotion test in Table 4 on the same post-exclusion target contrast, parameterized happy minus angry. Table 2 does not print a separate p for an unadjusted standardized mean difference. Success label follows authors' protocol-specific narrative, which also states all three effects were in the original direction and substantially smaller than the original. Full primary publisher PDF was accessible through the web tool after direct terminal retrieval returned 403; no retry of that terminal route.
